skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — combine these clips into a 60-second video with transitions and text overl...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Maker Free Download App — create and export videos online from uploaded clips and images.
- Simple workflow: upload files (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG) up to 500MB, describe your video needs, receive finished MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- No installation or professional editing skills required; AI handles video assembly with transitions, text overlays, and audio tracks.
- Free to use with 100 credit starter token; supports export, credits check, and session management.
- Cloud-based rendering (up to 1080p); supports a wide range of media formats for import and export.
- Designed for casual creators and students seeking fast, easy video editing without desktop software.
